br_cr02h.why: RA rev 81: the class bits arrive at 0 and the op-class decode (Pipeline tab) is timed inside rcu_pred. The decode table is TI's to generate (RI-14 follow-up); until rcu_pred takes the opcode and decodes it, the decode's 5 NGD (Partition tab: issue payload to bank predecode) sits here at the port so the path is timed whole: 12.5 NGD on to the guard's force term, 17.5 in all.

dq_cr02h.why: The demotion reads D0-D3 to rcu_mig's dm_pay (Partition tab: pred out 5, mig in 8). The rows that drive it also start the merge write path (old read, merge, row D), 17.6 NGD with the fanout term; held to the output's budget (NGD-7) they need 18, leaving mig 7 to capture the row (its R2 capture is 3). Copying the 1,536 row flops for the output is the alternative.
